name: Zyu
source: An amnesiac boy who has a calm and rational personality, but can also act ruthlessly when the situation requires it. The only fragments he has of his memories are "I need to find my wife whom I treasured a lot" and "I am a Tower Base". Just like [url=/c57596]Jack[/url] he is a Chishiki Boy.
translation: An amnesiac boy who has a calm and rational personality, but can also act ruthlessly when the situation requires it. The only fragments he has of his memories are "I need to find my wife whom I treasured a lot" and "I am a Tower Base". Just like [url=/c57596]Jack[/url] he is a Chishiki Boy.
